title: How Many Longest Climbs
statement:
Given a sequence of `n` integers, consider its strictly increasing subsequences (they keep the original order and may skip elements). Count how many different strictly increasing subsequences have the maximum possible length. Two subsequences are different if they use different positions, even when the values are equal.

Print the count modulo `1000000007`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the number of longest strictly increasing subsequences modulo `1000000007`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 20000`
- `1 <= a_i <= 99999`
